animation_sets.behavior: Use while resting on desktop or window top.
Advance along a horizontal desktop/window edge; mirror for left motion only if the bag/phone asymmetry is acceptable.
Place at a window or screen edge, clipping below or behind the edge.
Anchor pivot at hands; keep contact point locked to the edge.
Play after an intentional loss of support; transition to idle or sit.
Choose a single task pose or use as a slow montage; do not interpolate between unrelated props.
